tagline: Leading Spain's energy transition through regulated electric infrastructure and digital connectivity
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of Redeia's organic growth strategy, particularly in regulated electric infrastructure and connectivity, reflecting its central role in Spain's energy transition.

kpis.name: Total Organic Investment
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in the group's organic activities, primarily in regulated electric networks.
kpis.description: Organic investment reached 824.5 M€ in 2023, a 55% increase compared to 532 M€ in 2022, supported by network deployment for renewable energy.
kpis.signal: 55% investment increase, signaling strong commitment to energy transition and renewable energy integration.

kpis.name: Group EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Gross operating profit of the group, key operational performance indicator.
kpis.description: Group EBITDA stood at 1,507.8 M€ in 2023, a slight increase of 1.1% compared to 1,491 M€ in 2022.
kpis.signal: Moderate EBITDA growth despite challenging macroeconomic environment, maintaining operational stability of the group.

kpis.name: Consolidated Group Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net profit after taxes of the group.
kpis.description: Group consolidated profit advanced 3.7% in 2023 to reach 689.6 M€, compared to 665 M€ in 2022.
kpis.signal: 3.7% net profit improvement demonstrating effective cost management and improving profitability.

kpis.name: Return on Invested Capital
kpis.explanation: Profitability indicator measuring return on capital invested in the company, key for CEO variable compensation.
kpis.description: ROIC is one of three main annual objectives for CEO variable compensation in 2024 with a weighting of 32.5%, alongside consolidated earnings (32.5%) and organic investment (35%).
kpis.signal: Strategic objective weighted at 32.5% in 2024 CEO variable compensation, reflecting importance of capital efficiency.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid per share to shareholders.
kpis.description: Dividend per share is maintained at 1.00 € for 2023, identical to 2022, reflecting the group's stable distribution policy.
kpis.signal: Continued commitment to stable shareholder remuneration, dividend unchanged at 1.00 € versus 2022.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Total number of employees is not mentioned in the provided excerpts from the 2024 compensation report.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the provided documents.

kpis.name: Cumulative Progress on 2023-2025 Sustainability Plan
kpis.explanation: Progress indicator for the 2023-2025 sustainability plan, target set at 75% by end of 2024.
kpis.description: Cumulative progress on the 2023-2025 sustainability plan is set at 75% as the achievement target by end of 2024, representing 15% weighting of CEO operational objectives.
kpis.signal: Ambitious sustainability objective integrated at 15% of CEO variable compensation, aligning executives and ESG strategy.

kpis.name: Share of Sustainability Objectives in 2020-2025 Long-Term Incentive Plan
kpis.explanation: Share of objectives linked to sustainability in the long-term incentive plan, of which 45% dedicated to energy transition.
kpis.description: The long-term incentive plan (2020-2025) integrates 75% of sustainability objectives: energy transition in Spain (45%), digital connectivity (15%), sustainability plan compliance (10%) and HR matters (5%).
kpis.signal: 75% of LTIP objectives linked to sustainability, of which 45% to energy transition and 15% to digital connectivity, demonstrating CEO long-term alignment with ESG strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or its applications in the provided documents. Redeia's strategy focuses on energy transition, regulated electric infrastructure, narrowing the digital divide, and connectivity.
evidence: No reference to AI or related technologies in the 2024 directors' compensation annual report
Strategic objectives oriented toward organic investment (824.5 M€), sustainability and capital profitability
Long-term compensation plan (2020-2025) centered on energy transition (45%), connectivity (15%), sustainability (10%) and human resources (5%)
